title: View the contents of a plist file
summary: Display the contents of one or more property list (plist) files in a human-readable format. This is useful for inspecting configuration files without opening them in a code editor.

steps.explain: Use the -p flag to print the contents of the specified plist file(s) in a readable format.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the plist file you want to view
